name: Colossus Tech Club

summary: Colossus Tech Club is a student technology club in the Department of Information Science and Engineering at Akshaya Institute of Technology, Tumakuru, Karnataka, India.
activities: The club gives students practical experience through coding workshops, hackathons and team projects. Explore past events and project listings, or contact the club about taking part.
